# Requirement Quality Checklist: Unique User Context

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability for Phase 11 Unique User Context requirements prior to implementation.  
**Created**: 2026-10-27  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. Requirement Completeness: Travel Style Narrative & Prompt Decomposition

- [x] CHK001 - Are the input validation boundaries (minimum/maximum length, character encoding, whitespace trimming) explicitly specified for `travel_style_description`? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-CTX-002, Spec §REQ-CTX-006]
- [x] CHK002 - Are the decomposition categories for prompt synthesis exhaustively defined, including the exact schema contract for `description`, `reason_to_visit`, and `time_spent`? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-CTX-005]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the fallback behavior for empty or brief (< 10 chars) narratives explicitly specified regarding database cleanup and cache eviction? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-CTX-006, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 - Does the specification define whether the prompt synthesis task during profile save is executed synchronously or asynchronously, including UI feedback during processing? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-CTX-003, Spec §REQ-CTX-005, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK005 - Are the visual structure and labels of the read-only preview cards for generated prompt directives fully specified for the Web App profile page? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-CTX-007]

## 2. Requirement Clarity & Measurability: AI Synthesis & Grounding Guardrails

- [x] CHK006 - Is the maximum end-to-end latency threshold for prompt decomposition during profile save quantified with an objective metric? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK007 - Are the non-overlapping POI theme synthesis requirements unambiguous in preventing hallucinations and irrelevant preference injections? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-CTX-030, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK008 - Does the specification explicitly define how secondary scraping sources (e.g., Wikipedia, TripAdvisor) must be aggregated with primary content before being passed to personalized prompt synthesis? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-CTX-032]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the prompt injection defense mechanism clearly defined with explicit prompt boundary delimiters and structured output constraints? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the visit duration adjustment logic quantified with specific bounds or heuristics rather than subjective descriptions? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-CTX-031, Spec §User Story 2]

## 3. Requirement Consistency: POI Schema & Visual Hierarchy Parity

- [x] CHK011 - Is the separation of semantic concern between `description` ("what it is") and `reason_to_visit` ("why visit") consistently maintained across all domain entity definitions? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-CTX-023]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the mandatory visual order—`Reason to Visit` rendered directly below `Description`—consistently specified across all Web App forms (Edit Drawer, Manual Add Modal, Detail Drawer) and the Chrome Extension capture overlay? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-CTX-034, Spec §REQ-CTX-035, Spec §REQ-CTX-036, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK013 - Do the API request and response schemas maintain 1:1 parity for `reason_to_visit` across POI creation, retrieval, updating, and extraction contracts? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-CTX-021, Spec §REQ-CTX-022]
- [x] CHK014 - Does the specification explicitly detail how legacy POIs with `reason_to_visit = NULL` are displayed and edited in the UI without causing rendering errors? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]

## 4. Requirement Quality: Search & Discoverability

- [x] CHK015 - Are the search fields for backend POI keyword queries explicitly defined to include both `description` and `reason_to_visit`? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-CTX-024]
- [x] CHK016 - Is the search recall requirement for terms located exclusively within `reason_to_visit` quantified with an objective success criterion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK017 - Are client-side table and map filter requirements aligned with backend search requirements regarding `description` and `reason_to_visit` matching? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-CTX-025]
- [x] CHK018 - Does the specification explicitly require trigram database index coverage across both `description` and `reason_to_visit` for search performance? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-CTX-026]

## 5. Requirement Completeness: In-Memory Caching & Performance

- [x] CHK019 - Is the in-memory cache lookup latency quantified with a measurable threshold (e.g., < 2ms for 99% of requests)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §REQ-CTX-017]
- [x] CHK020 - Are the cache invalidation triggers comprehensively specified for all mutation paths (save narrative, clear narrative, user deletion)? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-CTX-006, Spec §REQ-CTX-018, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the cache error handling requirement explicitly defined to fall back to direct database retrieval without throwing unhandled exceptions? [Resilience, Spec §REQ-CTX-019]
- [x] CHK022 - Does the specification define cache TTL expiration, maximum memory bounds, or eviction policy for inactive tenant entries? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## 6. Scenario & Flow Coverage: Onboarding, Login Redirection & Extension Scenarios

- [x] CHK023 - Are the trigger criteria for displaying the login onboarding modal unambiguously defined for both newly registered and un-migrated legacy accounts? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-CTX-009, Spec §REQ-CTX-010]
- [x] CHK024 - Is the primary CTA redirect target (`/profile`) and narrative textarea focus behavior clearly specified for the onboarding modal? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-CTX-011]
- [x] CHK025 - Are the dismissal semantics ("Remind Me Later" / close button) defined regarding session persistence and re-triggering rules? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-CTX-012, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK026 - Does the specification explicitly state that the Chrome Extension must NOT display onboarding modals or block POI capture when travel style is unconfigured? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-CTX-013, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK027 - Are the non-intrusive presentation requirements defined for when an unconfigured traveler accesses a direct deep-link (e.g., `/itinerary/123`)? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]

## 7. Architecture & Non-Functional Invariants: Tenant Isolation & Governance

- [x] CHK028 - Is tenant isolation explicitly required across all database queries, cache keys, and prompt synthesis workflows (`WHERE user_id = :current_user_id`)? [Traceability, Spec §REQ-CTX-001, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK029 - Is the database modeling for `prompt_type` constrained to Python `StrEnum` backed by `VARCHAR(32)` to strictly prevent native PostgreSQL ENUM migrations? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-CTX-015]
- [x] CHK030 - Does the specification state that deleting a user account must cascade to all records in `user_prompts` and evict cached entries? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-CTX-014, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 - Is the rule prohibiting retroactive modification of existing POIs upon travel style update explicitly documented to protect user edits and token budgets? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-CTX-008, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK032 - Are batch CSV import requirements specified to guarantee that every row receives personalized enrichment via the same cached prompt pipeline as browser captures? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-CTX-033, Spec §User Story 4]
